SPELL_LAUNCHER.Settings.SpellLibrary.Hin: JSON object mapping spell-name → animation. Each value: { kind, file }. Kind = range | cone | marker | teleport. Spell names must match the actor's sheet exactly (case-sensitive). Only mapped spells appear in the per-actor palette. Invalid JSON falls back to defaults — check browser console for parse errors.
